headline: Symrise Shares Drop 10% Following Slower Fourth-Quarter Growth Forecast
summary: Shares in Symrise tumbled 10% after the German flavours and fragrances manufacturer warned of slowing revenue growth in the fourth quarter, overshadowing a sales beat in the third quarter.
why: Symrise is a MDAX-listed global supplier of scents, flavours, and cosmetic ingredients, serving international consumer packaged goods companies.

impacts.name: Symrise AG
impacts.why: A downbeat fourth-quarter sales forecast prompted a 10% sell-off in the company's shares.

why_moved: Symrise equity dropped 10% after management guided for slower revenue growth in the final quarter of the year despite beating third-quarter sales expectations.
